narratives.Description: ci(smoke): greenfield-python-free-smoke exits 143 (SIGTERM) with no stdout after engine-invoke
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

`greenfield-python-free-smoke` (`node packages/core/dist/release-e2e/greenfield-python-free-smoke-cli.js`) fails on PRs that touch `engine:invoke` / Taskfile dispatch with **exit code 143** (SIGTERM) and **no stdout**.

Observed on PR #2551 (`fix(taskfile): argv-safe ENGINE_CMD forwarding` / #2547) both before and after rebase onto master:

- Job runs ~48–80s then dies: `Process completed with exit code 143`
- No smoke CLI output in the failed-log snippet
- Re-run of the failed job reproduced the same 143

Other CI on that PR was green (TypeScript, Windows task dispatch, Greptile, Go).

## Why it matters

- Soft-blocks merge confidence for Taskfile / engine-invoke changes even when smoke is not in `master` required status checks
- May indicate a hang (then runner SIGTERM) in the consumer deposit `task` path after `tasks/engine-invoke.cjs` landed
- Windows release cohort (#2544–#2548) merged despite this; the gate is still unreliable for future cuts

## Suspected area

- `tasks/engine.yml` + `tasks/engine-invoke.cjs` (#2547 / PR #2551)
- Greenfield smoke path that invokes `task` / `deft` in a consumer deposit after content prepack
- Possible hang waiting on shell/spawn rather than an assertion failure

## Expected

- Smoke either passes with clear logs or fails with a diagnostic (timeout message, last step, stderr)
- No silent 143 when the suite is otherwise healthy
- If the job is over budget, fail closed with an explicit timeout rather than SIGTERM with empty output

## Acceptance

- [ ] Reproduce greenfield-python-free-smoke 143 on a minimal engine-invoke / Taskfile change (or document as flake with rate)
- [ ] Root cause: hang vs OOM vs runner timeout vs spawn deadlock
- [ ] Fix or harden: progress logs, bounded timeout, and/or repair engine-invoke consumer path
- [ ] Smoke green on a PR that exercises `task release` / `engine:invoke` on Linux CI

## Related

- Refs #2547 / PR #2551 (engine-invoke JSON env + argv spawn)
- Adjacent Windows maintainer friction: #2546 (vitest), #2548 (pnpm PATHEXT)
- Observed during v0.77.0 Windows release cohort merge
